articles.title: ESA's Juice Gains Speed During Earth Flyby Toward Jupiter
articles.summary: Juice passed 8,640 kilometers above Earth on September 28. The gravity assist saved fuel, increased its speed and provided a chance to test instruments for Jupiter.

articles.title: Looped Propeller Design Aims to Reduce Noise Near Whales
articles.summary: Sharrow Marine reports lower underwater noise from its looped propellers and is working with Ocean Alliance to test the design near whales.

articles.title: Scientists Study How a Queen Mole-Rat's Scent Shapes Colony Life
articles.summary: Researchers tested a queen naked mole-rat's scent and found effects on colony behavior, female hormones and reproduction.
